name: web-luxury-property-site-on-laptop-over-brown-leather-sofa
title: Real-estate site on a laptop resting on a dark brown leather sofa inside a cream frame
whatItIs: A laptop showing a sunset skyline hero with giant 'ELYSIUM GROUP' letters sits on a chocolate leather sofa with a cushion behind, in low warm light, framed by a thin cream rounded line on deep brown.
whatItMeans: Rich and comfortable; leather and gold-hour skyline signal luxury living.
techniques: Choose a furniture material that matches the brand palette.
Frame with a thin cream border on the slide colour.
Let the screen's sunset add the only colour.

vocabulary.definition: A scene surface that echoes the palette.
A thin light border around an image.
A hero built on a city photograph.
